name: App Store
author: Enplace
summary: Follow an app on the App Store: its icon, live version, review, rating, reviews and downloads.
description: Goes on an app product. Link the app to its App Store listing to get its icon, the live version and its rating, and add your Apple account in Settings → Connections to follow each version through review and read its reviews. With the account's vendor number too, it shows downloads, purchases and where they come from. With Release cycle on, the cycle numbers releases from what's live and follows each one through review. Builds come from says who makes the app's builds (a plugin like Xcode Cloud, an agent on your Mac, or you in Xcode), for every plugin that asks for one, like TestFlight. For Android, add Google Play to the same product.

connections.for: follows each version through review, and reads sales and reviews

settings.name: On the project's overview
settings.help: How the app's downloads, rating and reviews show on the overview. The App page always has all of it.
